meta.name: web-accessibility
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user is building or reviewing any web UI. Accessibility is a baseline requirement, not a niche concern. Covers WCAG 2.2 AA, semantic HTML, ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, focus management, color contrast, touch targets, forms, and testing with axe / screen readers. Trigger when generating any interactive component or page (forms, modals, menus, tables, navigation, layouts), before any "launch" or "go live", during pre-launch checklists, and whenever producing new HTML/JSX markup, even if the user does not explicitly mention a11y or WCAG. Skip for backend-only changes, CLI tools, or non-UI code.
